What changed in this PR Improves OpenAI chat and embeddings error classification in spans and operation-duration metrics. **Changes:** - Uses allowlisted service codes while preserving exception-class fallback. - Adds sync, async, and streaming error tests. - Documents classification behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | instrumentation/​openai/​openai-java-1.1/​library/​src/​test/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​openai/​v1_1/​ServiceErrorTest.java | Tests service-code classification and fallback telemetry. | | instrumentation/​openai/​openai-java-1.1/​library/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​openai/​v1_1/​OpenAiErrorType.java | Adds shared service-code classification. | | instrumentation/​openai/​openai-java-1.1/​library/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​openai/​v1_1/​EmbeddingAttributesGetter.java | Applies classification to embeddings. | | instrumentation/​openai/​openai-java-1.1/​library/​src/​main/​java/​io/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​openai/​v1_1/​ChatAttributesGetter.java | Applies classification to chat. | | instrumentation/​openai/​openai-java-1.1/​library/​README.md | Documents supported codes and fallback behavior. |
Review effort: Balanced

[Testing] This subset assertion accepts unexpected span attributes and does not check the streaming flag or partial-response ID/model. Use `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)` with those conditional attributes, as required by the test guidelines and used in `AbstractChatTest.java:935`. This is a nonblocking test-assertion improvement.

Use structured OpenAI service codes for `error.type` on chat and embeddings spans and operation-duration metrics—for example, `context_length_exceeded` instead of `com.openai.errors.BadRequestException`.

- **Classification:** Allowlist known codes to bound cardinality. Retain exception-class fallback for transport failures and missing, blank, malformed, or unrecognized codes; never classify from messages.
- **Scope:** Cover sync/async calls, streaming request failures, and existing async SSE terminal callbacks. Leave lifecycle, status, and cancellation policies unchanged; exclude Responses API errors and blocking SSE iteration failures.
metadata.title: Classify OpenAI chat and embeddings errors by service code
